title: Open-source round-trip evidence, identity normalization, and route readiness
mode: Primary-source repository and test-source review with local plan cross-check
scope: Inspect what current peer round-trip tests compare and which source identity or provenance fields they normalize away.
Reconcile DWG-RS container/entity coverage and writer claims with the evidence actually reported.
Refresh optional IxMilia DXF comparator and conditional external-tool test boundaries.
Refine the existing composed peer-comparison protocol without adding a peer to the fast validation loop.

method.limitations: GitHub main/master sources and project-authored test files are mutable and were not bound to a peer release artifact or executed. Their declarations establish test intent and route boundaries only. No local implementation mismatch was reproduced.

sources.observed: The general entity round-trip comparator normalizes both objects before equality. Its normalization clears handles, owners, reactors, extension-dictionary links, internal entity mode, raw-record provenance, and selected entity-specific references/collections. The suite also uses a same-ACadRust-writer/reader helper, a marker-bearing synthetic SAB helper, and a separate generated planar-body round-trip. These are useful internal regression patterns but do not establish whole-graph identity, independent native acceptance, or a general valid SAB profile.

The README separates container/object enumeration maturity from alpha/partial per-entity decoding, reports per-version decoded/skipped/errored observations over a small local corpus, and states that its alpha DWG writer lacks automated external CAD acceptance. The coverage ratios are corpus- and denominator-specific, not cross-project completeness scores.

IxMilia.Dxf documents DXF version/entity exclusions and warns that AutoCAD may reject selected output records. The Rust dxf-rs repository documents Windows/external ODA converter interop tests; these conditional tool branches must be recorded as PASS, FAIL, SKIP, or NOT_RUN rather than inferred from a green process exit. Neither route is a DWG or ACIS semantic implementation.

plan_impact.existing_composed_gate_refinement: Capture source-to-output identity and owner/reference closure before applying any peer's normalized field equality; record each normalization rule explicitly.
plan_impact.peer_results: Record exact version/direction, per-source-identity disposition, record-type denominator, warning/skip/error state, and conditional test outcome. Keep same-codec round-trip as internal consistency only.
plan_impact.acis_semantics: Separate synthetic marker/framing, same-codec round-trip, independent parser/kernel with independently authored analytic expectations, and native application acceptance.

repository_state: Plan and research receipt updated in a broadly dirty shared worktree. No files were staged or committed.
